How partnering works

Three steps.

  1. 01Apply

    Tell us what you build and show work you have shipped — in the chat below, in your own words.

  2. 02Get approved

    The studio looks at your work. Approved partners are listed here with their projects, rates and availability.

  3. 03Take the work

    Customers hire you directly and pay you directly. You build with Loki, OrangeCat and Solon — the same tools the studio uses. The studio takes no cut.

Partners are independent. A customer contracts with the partner, not with bitbaum.
